errorSignature: Vercel headless deployment fails after login
rootCause: Vercel CLI headless deploys ('vercel --prod --yes') fail if the project isn't previously linked via a local '.vercel/' directory.
resolution: Require the user to link the project interactively once before autonomous swarm takeover.
preventionRule: Always ensure the Vercel project is interactively linked before delegating deployment to headless CI/CD or autonomous swarm agents.
